Standard: Roll inceptor characteristics do not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the control forces and displacements as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Lateral-Directional Control with Speed Changes paragraph, Lateral-Directional Control with Speed Changes-Asymmetric Loads paragraph, and Lateral-Directional Control Forces and Displacements paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle flying/handling qualities for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle flying/handling qualities for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
